title: Injectivity of the Cloned Query Map
statement: Let $X$ be a type, let a repeated query scope on $X$ have arity $r$, let $M$ be a natural number, and assign to each of its $r$ positions a clone label in $\{1,\ldots,M\}$. If the assignment of clone labels is injective, then the map sending each position to its original query together with its clone label is injective.
hypotheses_covered: A type $X$ and a repeated query scope on $X$
An assignment of clone labels to the scope positions
